changes_made.explanation: Consolidated tasks to focus on copyright-sensitive text generation, normalized model names to standard forms, removed duplicate/incorrect model variants, and simplified output descriptions while adding refusal responses as an important output type.
Normalized ROUGE-L to ROUGE base form and refusal rate to consistent capitalization. Removed duplicate refusal rate entry.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper uses LLMs for generation but not for post-generation evaluation.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. All evaluations were automated using metrics like LCS, ROUGE, and refusal rate.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on copyright compliance evaluation for LLM text generation. It uses automatic metrics (LCS, ROUGE, refusal rate) but no human or LLM-as-judge evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and metric variants.
